Name: Fish Finder
Author: Aair
Description:
[color=#f1c232][size=4][b][color=#6aa84f]Fish Finder[/color][/b][/size][/color]
[size=3]
Fish Finder let's you find the fishing spots more easily. 

Just hold the fishing rod and use the information on the screen to find the spot.[/size]

[color=#6aa84f][size=4][b]How To install[/b][/size][/color]
[size=3]Download and unzip the file and place the Fish Finder folder into the Stardew Valley Mod folder.[/size]

[color=#6aa84f][size=4][b]Mod Compatibility
[/b][/size][/color][size=3]There should be no mod conflicts.[/size]

[color=#6aa84f][size=4][b]More Information[/b][/size][/color]
[size=3]For configuration settings, please look at the read me at [url=https://github.com/AairTheGreat/StardewValleyMods/tree/master/Fish%20Finder]Fish Finder GitHub site.[/url][/size]

[color=#6aa84f][size=4][b]Supported Languages
[/b][color=#ffffff][size=3]This mod now supports the following languages:

[*][size=3]Simplified Chinese [/size]
